# Frequently Asked Questions
## Have questions? We're here to answer them.

## OPERATIONS
### Are you open?
Yes. Exhibit and livery hours are on the Hours & Location page: [Exhibit and Livery Hours Can Be Found Here.](https://www.cwb.org/hourslocations) Museum hours: Tuesday - Sunday, 10 am - 5 pm.
### Can I just look at the boats?
Yes. Admission is always free and the docks are open to the public. Part of the docks closes during youth programs.
### Is your Cama Beach location open?
The lower portion of Cama Beach State Park is closed. See coverage from [KING5](https://www.king5.com/article/news/local/historic-cabins-cama-beach-state-park-permanently-close-commission-decides/281-b5883944-e59b-46f7-89ee-7f658daf9bd4).
### Are you accepting volunteers?
Yes. Apply via the [online application](https://www.cwb.org/volunteer). A mandatory volunteer orientation is held 10-11 am on the second Saturday of each month.
### Is there parking?
CWB has no parking of its own. Options include the city lot south of the site on Valley Street, street parking along Westlake Avenue, and public transit.
### Are you still running Sunday Public Sail?
Yes. 2026 Public Sail dates: April 12, May 10, June 14, July 26, August 30, and September 27.
### Can I use the restroom?
### Can I buy something in the Gift Shop?
Yes. Members receive 20% off gift shop purchases (some exclusions apply).
### Are you renting out facilities currently?
Yes. Submit the facility rental form and the Event Rentals Team will respond. [See this page](https://www.cwb.org/facility-rentals).

## PROGRAMS
### Which should I sign up for, SailNOW!, Basic Keelboat, or Private Sailing Lessons?
All three teach you to sail; choose based on your schedule, learning style, experience and budget. A Private Lesson Package is also available. Read [about each option here](https://www.cwb.org/adult-sailing-2).
### I see you are offering CLC Boatbuilding classes. Are these still proceeding?
Yes. Chesapeake Light Craft boatbuilding and other woodworking classes are offered — see [HERE](https://www.cwb.org/woodworking).

## LIVERY
### Does someone drive the boat?
Rentals are self-operated. For a captained cruise, see our [Charter Program](https://www.cwb.org/charters).
### Can I just do a checkout really quick before my rental?
Sailboat rentals require a passed sailing checkout, by appointment, [scheduled online](https://www.cwb.org/rent). Human-powered vessels have no prerequisites.
### Do you have life jackets?
Yes, life jackets are included with boat rentals.
### Can I bring my child on board?
Yes. Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
### Can I bring my dog?
Yes, dogs are welcome on leash and must stay on board. Staff may revoke this privilege.
### Can I bring a picnic?
Yes, picnics are allowed on boats. Drugs and alcohol are not.

## MEMBERSHIP
### How can I verify that my membership is current?
Email [membership@cwb.org](mailto:membership@cwb.org) or call 206-382-2628.
### I lost my CWB Membership card. Can I get a replacement?
You don't need your card to receive benefits — just a valid ID. Replacement requests: [membership@cwb.org](mailto:membership@cwb.org).
### I've moved! Who do I update at CWB?
Email [membership@cwb.org](mailto:membership@cwb.org) (newsletter/communications: [communications@cwb.org](mailto:communications@cwb.org)).
### I'm a Contributing or Captain's Circle member, and I lost my CAMM card (Council of American Maritime Museums Admission Privilege Card). Can I get a replacement?
Yes. Replacement cards take 7-10 days.
### What does CAMM and ROAM mean? What are reciprocal membership benefits, and how do I take advantage of them?
Contributing and Captain's Circle members receive reciprocal admission at participating museums. See the CAMM directory [here](https://councilofamericanmaritimemuseums.org/member-directory/) and the ROAM list [here](https://sites.google.com/site/roammuseums/home/list-of-roam-museums).

## Couldn't find your answer here? Give us a ring at (206) 382-2628.
